Full summary: Handoff API deprecated in v2.0 docs (issue #33 decision-only deliverable): README, TWINING-REFERENCE, UPGRADE-v2 note twining_handoff/acknowledge deprecation; redesign-vs-v3-removal deferred to v2.1 design pass. Milestones v2.0/v2.1 created; 4 teammates fanned out on #30/#31/#34/#35.
Decisions: Chose to deprecate twining_handoff/twining_acknowledge in v2.0 rather than redesign or remove now — field data (zero calls, 40+ markdown handoff docs) shows the surface doesn't fit usage, but the replacement design should be informed by W4 agent-identity work (#32), so the redesign-vs-v3-removal call moves to the v2.1 design pass. Tools keep working through v2.x.; Chose to put the deprecation note only in server docs (README.md, docs/TWINING-REFERENCE.md, docs/UPGRADE-v2.md), not plugin/BEHAVIORS.md or plugin skills — touching plugin/ forces a plugin version bump per CI, and the plugin-side handoff skill update belongs with the v2.1 design pass.; Chose worktree-isolated named teammates (weights-34, crosspost-30, supersede-31, archive-35) sharing one Twining blackboard with distinct agent_ids — dogfoods v2 parallel work streams as requested; controller integrates and commits per the subagent-commit-race feedback memory.
